title: Speech Works by Elissa - Videos
description:
Welcome to Speech Works by Elissa! We are dedicated to helping parents and caregivers of non-verbal or speech-delayed children take an active role in their child’s communication journey. Through our hands-on experience and proven strategies, we provide practical tips, tools, and guidance to help your child find their voice.

Our channel features videos on speech development, language techniques, and motor planning exercises—all aimed at empowering you to support your child at home. Whether your child has been diagnosed with autism, apraxia of speech, or is experiencing a speech delay, we’re here to help you unlock their potential.

Subscribe to join a community of parents who are transforming their child’s future, one word at a time!

www.speechworksbyelissa.com
